scope: Installed ephemeral browser direct launches with ES/services resident; no game, account sign-in, cloud operation, settings edit, firmware transfer or reboot. Not normal ES handoff qualification.
guards: Sampling thresholds; not reserved-memory guarantees. First owners PSI>5 or available<160MiB; final owner requires available<256MiB for PSI cutoff. All owners have absolute device-unit timeout.
limits: Single ordered preliminary trials; public content/timing can vary.
Guard-stopped durations differ; peak PSS is censored and does not rank renderer efficiency.
DRM shared buffers are not added to process PSS or summed across duplicate client IDs.
